name: Cártel Nueva Frontera (fictional)
inspired_by: A fast-expanding, paramilitary-style cartel from western Mexico: uniformed cells with unit insignia, armoured trucks, drone-dropped explosives and mines left as hazards, aggressive expansion into rivals' territory, and a leadership hit by a state decapitation strike. No real organisation, leader or emblem is used.
callout_language: Mexican Spanish (western slang, military-style radio calls)

doctrine.summary: The most military-looking armed group in the theatre. Cells wear matching camouflage, plate carriers and patches, move in convoys of armoured trucks, and fight in organised groups with radio discipline. The group is known for drone-dropped explosives, mines and improvised explosives on approach roads (game: map hazards), and for answering state pressure with mass blockades and arson across many towns at once. After a (fictional) decapitation strike against its founder the group is in a succession struggle that makes cells less predictable but no less violent.
doctrine.fireteam: Uniformed cells of 8-12 in two armoured trucks; pairs with a leader on the radio; specialist drone and explosives teams attached.
tactics: Uniformed assault cells in armoured trucks attacking rival plazas and police posts
Drone-dropped explosives on patrols and positions (game hazard)
Mined approach roads and booby-trapped safe houses (map hazards, marked by cues)
Mass blockades of burning vehicles across a region after an HVT operation
Ambushes on Army and Guardia Nacional convoys from high ground

camo.name: Uniformed cell camouflage (woodland/MultiCam-style)
camo.use: Matching uniforms with fictional unit patches

squad_leader: M4-pattern rifle with optic and radio

launchers: 40 mm grenade launchers [not_in_game as launcher class]

body_armor.notes: Most uniformed cells have plate carriers and ballistic helmets (steel or ceramic plates); lookouts and recruits none.

vehicles.notes: Armoured 'monster' trucks, painted and marked with fictional unit initials; the group's trademark.
Commercially armoured SUVs for leaders and assault teams.
Drones dropping explosives on positions and patrols (game hazard).

unit_templates.name: Plaza defence (fortified ranch or town block)

support_assets: Mined or booby-trapped approaches (map hazard with visible cues)
Regional blockades: burning vehicles on many roads after an HVT strike

as_target: Break a regional blockade and reopen a highway
Destroy a drone workshop or explosives cache

notes: FICTIONAL cartel; no real organisation, leader, insignia or slogans are depicted. Inspired by the real-world type of a fast-expanding paramilitary western Mexican cartel; the real-world reference for the 'decapitation then nationwide blockades' beat is the February 2026 Army operation in Jalisco. Tone is game-level only. Hostile to the player, never hires or sells. At war with cartel_pacifico and with the Mexican state; in game the two cartels may fight each other on the same map.
proposed: unit_templates (roles lookout, drone_operator and driver are game roles)
